async def _ejecutar_resync_inventarios_fisicos(
    unidad_negocio_id: str,
    dry_run: bool,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Ejecuta el handler oficial de inventarios fisicos para una unidad canonica."""
    from core.scheduler.jobs.sync_compras_job import (
        _execute_sql_with_timeout,
        _get_servers_to_sync,
    )
    from modules.compras.sync_service import (
        INVENTORY_SYNC_MODE_FULL,
        log_sync_operation,
        sync_inventarios_fisicos_from_server,
    )

    unidad_codigo = str(unidad_negocio_id or "").strip().upper()
    servers = _get_servers_to_sync()
    selected = [
        server for server in servers
        if str(server.get("unidad_codigo") or "").strip().upper() == unidad_codigo
    ]
    if not selected:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "error_message": f"Unidad {unidad_codigo} no encontrada entre los servidores canonicos activos",
            "records_processed": 0,
        }

    if dry_run:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "modo": "DRY_RUN",
            "records_processed": 0,
            "targets": [
                {
                    "unidad": server.get("unidad_codigo"),
                    "server_id": server.get("id"),
                    "system_type": server.get("system_type"),
                    "sucursal_origen_id": server.get("sucursal_origen_id"),
                }
                for server in selected
            ],
            "message": "DRY RUN validado; no se modificaron inventarios fisicos.",
        }

    results = []
    total_records = 0
    total_details = 0
    errors = []
    for server in selected:
        sync_start = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        server_info = {
            "id": server["id"],
            "host": server["host"],
            "port": server["port"],
            "database": server["database"],
            "username": server["username"],
            "password": server["password"],
            "system_type": server["system_type"],
        }
        unidad_info = {
            "id": server["unidad_id"],
            "codigo": server["unidad_codigo"],
            "nombre": server["unidad_nombre"],
            "sucursal_origen_id": server.get("sucursal_origen_id"),
        }
        result = sync_inventarios_fisicos_from_server(
            server_info,
            unidad_info,
            _execute_sql_with_timeout,
            sync_mode=INVENTORY_SYNC_MODE_FULL,
        )
        sync_end = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        log_sync_operation(
            unidad_negocio_id=unidad_info["id"],
            server_id=server_info["id"],
            sync_type="INVENTARIOS",
            sync_start=sync_start,
            sync_end=sync_end,
            records_synced=int(result.get("records_synced") or 0),
            status=result.get("status", "ERROR"),
            error_message=result.get("error"),
        )
        row = {
            "unidad": unidad_info["codigo"],
            "server_id": server_info["id"],
            "system_type": server_info["system_type"],
            "sucursal_origen_id": unidad_info.get("sucursal_origen_id"),
            "status": result.get("status"),
            "records_synced": int(result.get("records_synced") or 0),
            "details_synced": int(result.get("details_synced") or 0),
            "details_updated": int(result.get("details_updated") or 0),
            "detail_errors": int(result.get("detail_errors") or 0),
            "error": result.get("error"),
        }
        results.append(row)
        total_records += row["records_synced"]
        total_details += row["details_synced"] + row["details_updated"]
        if row["status"] != "OK":
            errors.append(row["error"] or f"Inventarios {unidad_info['codigo']}: estado {row['status']}")

    return {
        "success": not errors,
        "records_processed": total_records,
        "details_processed": total_details,
        "results": results,
        "error_message": " | ".join(errors) if errors else None,
    }

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
API = ROOT / "backend/api/admin_scheduler_resync.py"
CATALOG = ROOT / "backend/modules/sistema/sync_catalogo_service.py"
MIGRATION = ROOT / "backend/migrations/sync_catalogo_canonico_20260612.py"
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend/src/pages/Reportes.js"


def test_inventory_resync_is_dispatched_before_unimplemented_guard():
    text = API.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    branch = text.index("if request.tipo_sync == 'inventarios_fisicos':")
    guard = text.index("# GUARD HONESTO: tipo registrado")
    assert branch < guard
    assert "sync_inventarios_fisicos_from_server" in text
    assert "INVENTORY_SYNC_MODE_FULL" in text
    assert "sucursal_origen_id" in text


def test_inventory_catalog_reports_runtime_handler_as_implemented():
    text = CATALOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "'inventarios_fisicos': 'sync_inventarios_fisicos'" in text
    assert "handler_implementado = True" in text


def test_inventory_seed_marks_handler_implemented_for_new_environments():
    text = MIGRATION.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    block = text.split("dict(codigo='inventarios_fisicos'", 1)[1].split("),", 1)[0]
    assert "handler='sync_inventarios_fisicos'" in block
    assert "impl=1" in block


def test_inventory_frontend_warns_when_cached_list_may_be_stale():
    text = FRONTEND.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    warning = "Se conserva la ultima lista cargada; puede estar desactualizada."
    assert text.count(warning) >= 2
